text:
ops-bot: ALERT: Canary rollout 2026-03-15T02:00Z (model v4.3) -> streaming endpoints us-west-2 showing p99 spike and partial stalls. Severity: S2. Trigger: p99 > 2.5s for >5m. Paging @oncall-latency @sara @miguel @nisha :rotating_light:

sara: acked. Pulling traces and recent deploys. Any traffic shift details from deploy bot?

miguel: I see traffic ramp from 10% -> 45% over 12m for canary route /stream/gen (autoscale hopped up). Baseline p99 was ~600ms, now 2.8-3.4s. p95 stayed ~420-480ms.

nisha: streaming stalls reported by customer X in chat. Looks like many requests are hanging at first token generation, KV hit rate dropped. KV cache evictions spiked.

hamid: uploading a quick qprofile, but early hunch is attention kernel misbehavior with long context in v4.3 quant.

eva: customer-success oncall reporting two customers saw timeouts (client-side 10s). Raised support ticket #INC-4721 and told them we're investigating.

deploy-bot: Deploy v4.3 canary started 2026-03-15T01:52Z -> targets: canary-pool-usw2-3. Traffic ramp policy: linear to 50% over 15m.

miguel: can we temporarily cap canary traffic to 10%? Suggest target reduction + enable fallback to v4.2 if latency >1.5s for >3m.

sara: I'm going to throttle the canary route and initiate a partial rollback plan. Steps: 1) throttle -> 10%; 2) enable fallback routing to v4.2 for streaming; 3) watch p99 for 5m; 4) if stable, proceed with controlled rollback.

nisha: Sara, ping when you throttle so I can cut over customer traffic if needed. Also collecting heap/gpu-mem graphs now.

sara: throttled canary to 10% now (console action id: act_8421).

ops-bot: ACTION: route.modify applied -> /stream/gen canary -> 10% (actor: sara).

miguel: I flipped fallback routing to v4.2 for streaming (route rule id: fallback-v4.2). New requests will prefer v4.2 on latency breach.

hamid: KV cache miss rate returned to baseline after throttle. p99 dropped to 720ms within 2m, p95 unchanged. Looks promising.

eva: I told customer X support: "We've throttled the canary and enabled fallback; engineers see p99 improving. Will follow up in 30m."

nisha: collecting stack traces from affected workers. Not seeing obvious OOMs, but some CUDA kernel retries logged around edge shards. Posting snippet:
```
[2026-03-15T02:05:12Z] worker-23 kernel_retry: attention_kernel_launch failed, retrying (attempt 2)
[2026-03-15T02:05:12Z] worker-23 kvcache: eviction_count +342 in 60s
```

sara: good catch. Miguel, can you hold the canary at 10% and we prepare a full rollback if any regressions? Also page runtime-eng if kernel vendor patch is needed.

miguel: holding at 10%. Paging @hamid for runtime-eng deep dive.

hamid: joining. Based on traces, the new fused attention path in v4.3 regresses on sequences >1024 when quantized q4_0. Short contexts OK. Suggest: 1) disable fused attention kernel for canary workers (config flag), 2) or rollback canary completely. Which do we want first?

sara: we don't have a safe config toggle for prod-wide kernel switch without restart. Given customer impact, proceed with rollback. Miguel, initiate rollback of canary pods to v4.2 and drain canary-pool-usw2-3.

miguel: starting rollback now. Command: `redwood deploy rollback --target canary-pool-usw2-3 --to-version v4.2 --grace 30s`

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated by miguel. Progress: 0% -> 60% -> 100%. All canary nodes replaced with v4.2.

ops-bot: NOTE: rollback completed at 2026-03-15T02:12Z (actor: miguel).

nisha: post-rollback metrics: p99 at 610-750ms across streaming endpoints, KV miss rate normalized, no more kernel_retry logs.

eva: I updated customer X: "We've rolled back the canary and metrics show latency back to expected levels. Sorry for the disruption, we'll follow-up with root cause." They asked for incident timeline and mitigation — CS will prepare template.

sara: creating incident runbook and will escalate to RC for follow-up: cause = fused-attention regression in v4.3 quant path causing KV pressure and kernel retries on long contexts; mitigation = rollback to v4.2, throttle policy, fallback routing. Next steps: repro locally, patch kernel or model quant config, add canary health checks for kv eviction and kernel_retry logs as gating.

hamid: I'll open ticket with runtime team and vendor if needed. cc: @nisha for traces and @miguel for deploy details.

oncall-latency: handing off to daytime oncall @sara for postmortem and customer comms. Leaving notes in incident channel. :white_check_mark:

sara: thanks all. I'll turn this into an incident doc and assign owners for RCA and postmortem. Closing live paging.

ops-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: status -> mitigated. Severity downgraded to S3 at 2026-03-15T02:20Z."
